headline: Holding on to topline acceleration key

highlights: The 13% tonnage growth in Q2 and 16% revenue growth are particularly encouraging.
Growth trends across channels and states continue to improve, translating into sequential market share gains.
EBITDA margin, at 18.3%, saw 150bps contraction, driven by GM pressure of 200bps.
Management noted that inflationary pressures remain elevated in the near term.
